en: So, you knew the Gigants' signs after all.

en: That'll do.
Perfect. Then let's get swinging.
You still breathing, Shinada?
Somehow.
Let me ask you something first.
I need to know, please.
He was... conflicted.
Conflicted?
He told me as much.
No point regretting it now.
So, even if I go up against Shinada tomorrow...
I'll do just what you told me, Fujita-san.
The curveball?
Breaking balls do give him trouble.
What's done is done.
And if we fail, it's all over.
I know that. I really do.
Still...
This is what Fujita-san said next.

"I won't let Shinada end up a tool for
match fixing. He's far too special for that."

"I'd rather retire from the league
than tarnish that talent."
He said all that?
That game 15 years ago.
Even if you hadn't hit that home run...
And the Tojo Clan out of Nagoya for good.
So Fujita-san made a decision.
In return for selling his soul to the Kuroha...
He'd protect the one thing he held dearest.
Which was what?
His love of the game.
And the man who could keep that love alive.
For Fujita-san, you represented hope.
The one clean act in the entire Wyverns lineup.
The only light in a world of dark.
Pure, genuine baseball.
That's the truth.
You can tell me all about that home run later.
Don't want these guys getting in the way.
We're settling this.
Our rivalry, that is.
So, we really doing this?
And what, this'll show me?
Yup. No doubt.
Damn straight I do.
Now bring it!
Heh. Not bad.
Besides, I'm just warming up.
Try this on for size.
My <Italic>real</Italic> fastball.
I thought you've been itching for a rematch.
What happened!?

en: Was that home run just a fluke? Huh!?

Next.

en: It's the seventh pitch.

Time to end this once and for all.
Home run.

none of this would have happened."

en: Get your ass up here, Aizawa.
Take me out and find Morinaga.

"And if seein' him again doesn't
settle the matter for ya..."
Then pummel him 'til you're satisfied.
Wallow in self pity all ya want...

"But when your brother starts
strayin' down the wrong path..."
It's up to you to set him straight.
So move it, Aizawa.
Let's go, Aizawa.
The bond between sworn brothers ain't broken yet.
Ya proved that much.
'Course it isn't.
Then you gotta put your faith in Morinaga now.

"It ain't about whether or
not he cast aside your oath."
What matters is, are you gonna accept that?
And that's it.

"The fights in that cage have
been some real snoozes lately."

"Haven't felt a rush like that
in who knows how many years."
Florist?
In return for giving me a real fight...
I'll tell you guys where Morinaga is now.
You mean that?
But the truth can be cruel.

"I can give you the reality, but
you need the courage to face it."
What're ya gettin' at?
So? You really wanna know, Aizawa?
Wherever fate's taken him...
I need to know where my aniki is!
This isn't a path I can walk alone.
I see. I'll tell you, then.
If you wanna find Morinaga now, he's...
In the Kamurocho PD basement.
The morgue, to be precise.
Omi...
Date-san!

"How many times do I have to tell you?
Keep your voice down at a crime scene!"

"Well, the pistol in the victim's hand...
We found another set of prints on it."
Two sets of prints?
Yes. I'm afraid that's not all.

"The Shibaura Wharf body we found
last night, the ex-Tojo Clan guy..."

"These prints match what we got
from the Morinaga murder."
What the hell? You got an ID on this guy yet?
But it's a little strange...
Actually, more than a little strange...
Really!? Just spit it out already!

"Sorry! We got a match on the
prints to this man here..."

"This is that talent agency president
who's been all over the news..."

"According to Organized Crime,
the talent agency's just a cover."
He's actually a ranking Omi Alliance officer.

"Public Security has had eyes
on him for a few years now."
Guess he's finally showing his true colors, huh?
Where is he now?

en: Our sources spotted him in Kamurocho.
He's in <Italic>Kamurocho</Italic>?
So, Fukuoka, Sapporo, and Nagoya...
Ka-chan's the one behind all of it?
That's how it looks, sir.

"Most of Ousaka Enterprises' men
are already in Kamurocho."
And the Tojo Clan's doin' fuck all!?

"It doesn't seem like they're putting
up much of a fight, to be honest..."

"Ousaka Enterprises may have struck
some kind of deal with the Tojo Clan."
Then what's goin' on in Sotenbori!?

"Word is it's been all but deserted,
except for a few holdouts."

"So he's leavin' his sorry Sotenbori turf
wide open for us, is he?"

"For a guy who acts like he couldn't give
a rat's ass, he's sure goin' to extremes."
C'mon! Get off your asses! Get yourselves ready!
Get ready for what?
It's time to go to war!

"We're marchin' on Tokyo too! Katsuya
ain't gettin' away with this if I can help it!"
I see. Understood.
So Watase-aniki is on the move.
No, don't worry.
It's too late for him to interfere now.
How goes the issue of that other matter?

"I see. Now all we have to do is wait
for all the players to come on stage."
Bye then.
Apologies. I have a lot on my plate right now.

"Regarding my proposal...
Have you given it any thought?"
I'm back.

en: Hey you, what are you doing in here!?

"What do you mean, ""Hey, you?""

"Yeah well, actually I'm looking
to borrow some money."
Well that's tricky, you see...

"Our head office in Kamurocho is
run by Hana-chan, the clerk..."

"I'm not at liberty to be handing

"I'm guessing you got turned down

"Trust me, I really need that

"The Japan Dome is hosting a major debut

en: You made it too.

"Talk, Katsuya. Whaddaya
got to say for yourself?"
You're making a move on the Tojo Clan, no?
What gives, Ka-chan?

"Ain't exactly your style
to be picking a fight, is it?"
Ya fired up?
Not every day this happens.

"Logic aside, could any yakuza

Watase-aniki?

How 'bout you, Kiryu-han?

"If the four of us take off the gloves,

en: You idiots need to listen to yourselves.

en: Then here goes.

Yes. He's the one behind all of this.
The Seventh Chairman of the Omi Alliance.

"My aim's slippin'. Can't hit
shit from this distance."

"When I'm done talking, I'll put

Die.

"Why, Ka-chan!?

"I hear ya! Just don't die on me!
Ka-chan, don't!"
Ka-chan! C'mon, Ka-chan!
I'll never forget this.
You're going to pay.
That's a promise!
I'm headin' over there to settle this right now!
Are ya now? Dumbass.

"Pretty big talk for a guy

How about me?

Chairman Kurosawa.
Daigo Dojima...
Daigo!?
